Complete the assignment below, thoroughly:

# Target
`flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart` (2896 lines) — a giant `class AgentService extends ChangeNotifier`. It ALREADY has 13 part files (agent_service_sessions.dart 410, agent_service_compaction.dart 305, agent_service_events.dart 290, agent_service_connection_guard.dart 230, agent_service_inbox.dart 168, agent_service_skills.dart 155, agent_service_runs.dart 136, agent_service_transcript.dart 134, agent_service_persistence.dart 121, agent_service_assistant.dart 121, agent_service_config.dart 119, agent_service_prompt.dart 66, and possibly more — list the directory). Open one existing part first to learn the exact pattern used (likely `part of 'agent_service.dart';` + mixin or plain extension of the class — FOLLOW IT EXACTLY).

# Change
1. Read agent_service.dart fully and map what remains in the main class body (per the ticket: session lifecycle / provider wiring / secrets / mail fabric / tool wiring / media — whatever you actually find).
2. Move cohesive member groups into NEW part files following the existing pattern EXACTLY (same mixin mechanism the existing parts use). If an existing part has a clearly-matching concern and stays under 2000 lines, extending it is fine too. Every moved member keeps its exact signature, name, and semantics.
3. Keep in the primary file: imports, part directives, the class declaration with its mixin list, constructor, and fields/members that don't split cleanly. Target: primary file < 2000 lines (extract at least ~900 lines). No part over 2000 lines.
4. Check for callers of the members you move: parts share the library scope so same-library access is unchanged, but if AgentService members are accessed from OUTSIDE via implicit interface (e.g. `AgentService` used as a type, `provider` getter consumed in widgets), moving members into mixins keeps them public — just verify with analyze + the tests below.

# Acceptance
- `wc -l flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service.dart` < 2000; no flutter_app/lib/services/agent_service*.dart over 2000.
- `dart format` clean on touched files.
- `cd flutter_app && flutter analyze --no-fatal-infos --no-fatal-warnings` reports no errors in services/ (other agents are NOT touching flutter_app — any error you see is yours to fix).
- Run the agent_service test group: `cd flutter_app && flutter test test/agent_service_provider_models_test.dart test/agent_service_runs_test.dart test/agent_service_sessions_test.dart test/agent_service_persistence_test.dart test/agent_service_inbox_test.dart 2>/dev/null` — first run `ls flutter_app/test | grep agent_service` to find the real filenames and run all agent_service-related unit tests (skip golden/widget tests if they need a display; report what you ran).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Mechanically move AgentService member blocks into part files."""
import re, sys

SRC = 'lib/services/agent_service.dart'
lines = open(SRC).read().split('\n')

# (group, signature regex)
MEMBERS = {
 'wiring': [
   r'^  StreamFunction _streamFunctionFor\(',
   r'^  void _attachRedactor\(',
   r'^  void _registerRedactionSecret\(',
   r'^  void _attachApproval\(',
   r'^  List<String> get registeredToolNamesForTest',
   r'^  List<Tool> get toolsForTest',
   r'^  String get systemPromptForTest',
   r'^  SecretsExecutionEnv\? get secretsEnvForTest',
   r'^  SecretRedactor\? get redactorForTest',
   r'^  SkillsAccess get skillsAccess',
   r'^  Future<void> setSkillsAccess\(',
   r'^  String _composeSystemPrompt\(',
   r'^  String _messagingSection\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _refreshMemorySection\(',
   r'^  String\? _projectMountNote\(',
   r'^  void refreshProjectMountPrompt\(',
   r'^  HarnessLlmSlot\? _resolveMemoryLlmSlot\(',
   r'^  AppLauncher\? get appLauncher',
   r'^  set appLauncher\(',
   r'^  Future<List<AskAnswer>\?> _answerAskQuestions\(',
   r'^  Future<RequestSecretResult\?> _handleSecretRequest\(',
   r'^  Map<String, String> hostSecrets\(\)',
   r'^  Future<RequestSecretResult> acceptSecretGrant\(',
 ],
 'history': [
   r'^  WindowedSessionStorage\? get _windowed',
   r'^  Future<void> _syncViewToWindow\(',
   r'^  int\? _positionalRow\(',
   r'^  Future<bool> _jumpLoadedRecord\(',
   r'^  Future<bool> _jumpToRecord\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _refreshHistoryAbove\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _applyViewBranch\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _reprojectLoadedWindow\(',
 ],
 'watch': [
   r'^  void _startSessionWatch\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _checkSessionFileGrew\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _reloadExternalMessages\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _growProviderContext\(',
   r'^  void _stopSessionWatch\(',
 ],
 'media': [
   r'^  bool get inlinesImageAttachments',
   r'^  MediaGateway\? get mediaGateway',
   r'^  VideoReader\? get videoReader',
   r'^  Future<AsrTranscriber\?> resolveAsrTranscriber\(',
   r'^  Future<void> sendImage\(',
 ],
 'background': [
   r'^  Future<void> _beginBackgroundTask\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _finishLiveActivity\(',
   r'^  String _liveActivityStatusText\(',
   r'^  void _pushLiveActivityStatus\(',
 ],
 'subagents': [
   r'^  SubagentManager\? get subagentManager',
   r'^  set subagentManager\(',
   r'^  Future<List<\(String, String\)>> observeSubagent\(',
   r'^  Future<void> sendToSubagent\(',
   r'^  SessionMetadata _subagentSessionMetadata\(',
   r'^  DynamicMessagesService _buildDynamicMessages\(',
   r'^  Future<RequestSecretResult\?> _requestSecretForWidget\(',
 ],
 'lifecycle': [
   r'^  void _clearError\(',
   r'^  String _shortArgs\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _flushDynamicWidgets\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _flushRequestSummaries\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _rebuildTrajectory\(',
 ],
}

def find_block(sig_re):
    """Return (start, end) 0-based inclusive line indices; start includes /// doc lines."""
    pat = re.compile(sig_re)
    hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.match(l)]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        print(f'FATAL: {sig_re!r} matched {len(hits)} lines', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
    i = hits[0]
    # walk back over doc comment lines
    s = i
    while s - 1 >= 0 and (lines[s-1].startswith('  ///') or lines[s-1].startswith('  // ')):
        # only absorb pure doc/comment lines, not code
        s -= 1
    # find end: brace balance from signature line
    depth = 0
    started = False
    e = i
    while e < len(lines):
        l = lines[e]
        depth += l.count('{') - l.count('}')
        if '{' in l:
            started = True
        e += 1
        if started and depth <= 0:
            break
        if not started and l.rstrip().endswith(';'):
            break
    return s, e - 1

blocks = {}  # group -> list of (start, end, text)
all_ranges = []
for group, sigs in MEMBERS.items():
    blocks[group] = []
    for sig in sigs:
        s, e = find_block(sig)
        text = '\n'.join(lines[s:e+1])
        blocks[group].append((s, e, text))
        all_ranges.append((s, e))

# sanity: no overlaps
all_ranges.sort()
for (s1, e1), (s2, e2) in zip(all_ranges, all_ranges[1:]):
    if s2 <= e1:
        print(f'FATAL: overlapping ranges {s1}-{e1} and {s2}-{e2}', file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

HEADER = """// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
// Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
// in the LICENSE file.

part of 'agent_service.dart';
"""

PARTS = {
 'wiring': ('agent_service_wiring.dart', 'AgentServiceWiring',
   "/// Backend stream-function picking, redaction + approval attachment,\n"
   "/// skills/tools consent setters, system-prompt composition, and the\n"
   "/// secret-request host handlers of [AgentService]. Library-private state\n"
   "/// stays on the class in `agent_service.dart`; members here read/write it\n"
   "/// directly (same library)."),
 'history': ('agent_service_history.dart', 'AgentServiceHistory',
   "/// Windowed-history internals of [AgentService] (issue #135): the\n"
   "/// paging/jump helpers BEHIND the [FaChatService] history surface. The\n"
   "/// `@override` banner members themselves stay on the class (an\n"
   "/// `implements` clause is satisfied only by real class members); these\n"
   "/// helpers share the class's private state (same library)."),
 'media': ('agent_service_media.dart', 'AgentServiceMedia',
   "/// Media surface of [AgentService]: the gateway/video-reader accessors\n"
   "/// behind the `jsr.fa.media.*` bridges, the ASR transcriber resolution,\n"
   "/// and the plain-image send path. The [FaChatService] attachment\n"
   "/// overrides stay on the class; the private gateway fields live there\n"
   "/// too (extensions hold no instance state)."),
 'background': ('agent_service_background.dart', 'AgentServiceBackground',
   "/// Background-execution + Live Activity helpers of [AgentService]\n"
   "/// (issues #325/#326, the iOS Dynamic Island / lock-screen status): the\n"
   "/// [isStreaming] setter that drives them is an `@override` and stays on\n"
   "/// the class; these helpers share its private state (same library)."),
 'subagents': ('agent_service_subagents.dart', 'AgentServiceSubagents',
   "/// Subagent observe/send surface of [AgentService] (the settings Agents\n"
   "/// section) plus the dynamic-messages host factory and the widget\n"
   "/// secret-request backend (issue #102). Private managers stay on the\n"
   "/// class; these members read them directly (same library)."),
 'lifecycle': ('agent_service_lifecycle.dart', 'AgentServiceLifecycle',
   "/// Session-lifecycle internals of [AgentService]: error clearing, the\n"
   "/// trajectory-ledger rebuild, and the dynamic-widget / request-capture\n"
   "/// record flushes that ride the persist pass. The state fields they\n"
   "/// drive stay on the class (same library)."),
}

for group, (fname, extname, doc) in PARTS.items():
    body = '\n\n'.join(t for _, _, t in blocks[group])
    out = HEADER + '\n' + doc + '\nextension ' + extname + ' on AgentService {\n' + body + '\n}\n'
    open('lib/services/' + fname, 'w').write(out)
    print(f'wrote lib/services/{fname}: {len(out.splitlines())} lines')

# watch group -> append inside the existing AgentServiceSessions extension
watch_body = '\n\n'.join(t for _, _, t in blocks['watch'])
sp = 'lib/services/agent_service_sessions.dart'
slines = open(sp).read().split('\n')
# find final closing brace of the extension (last line that is exactly '}')
idx = max(i for i, l in enumerate(slines) if l == '}')
slines[idx:idx] = ['', watch_body]
open(sp, 'w').write('\n'.join(slines))
print(f'appended watch group to {sp}')

# remove blocks from main file, collapse blank lines
remove = set()
for s, e in all_ranges:
    remove.update(range(s, e + 1))
new_lines = [l for i, l in enumerate(lines) if i not in remove]
out_text = '\n'.join(new_lines)
out_text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', out_text)

# add part directives after the last existing one
anchor = "part 'agent_service_inbox.dart';"
new_parts = '\n'.join(f"part '{PARTS[g][0]}';" for g in ('history', 'wiring', 'media', 'background', 'subagents', 'lifecycle'))
assert out_text.count(anchor) == 1
out_text = out_text.replace(anchor, anchor + '\n' + new_parts)
open(SRC, 'w').write(out_text)
print(f'main file now {len(out_text.splitlines())} lines')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 2: move remaining non-override members out of agent_service.dart."""
import re, sys

SRC = 'lib/services/agent_service.dart'
lines = open(SRC).read().split('\n')

# group -> list of signature regexes
MEMBERS = {
 'wiring': [
   r'^  ToolsConfig get toolsConfig',
   r'^  String get agentModelId',
 ],
 'lifecycle': [
   r'^  TrajectoryBlobPersister _trajectoryBlobPersisterFor\(',
   r'^  bool get providerAddFlowInProgress',
   r'^  bool reconfigureRefusedByAddFlow\(',
   r'^  void beginProviderAddFlow\(\)',
   r'^  void endProviderAddFlow\(',
 ],
 'inbox': [
   r'^  int get inboxWakeStreakForTest',
   r'^  set inboxWakeStreakForTest\(',
   r'^  ScheduledReceiptLog get scheduledReceiptsForTest',
 ],
 'sessions': [
   r'^  String\? get currentSessionId',
   r'^  String\? get currentSessionCwd',
   r'^  AgentConfig\? get configForClone',
 ],
}

PART_FILES = {
 'wiring': 'lib/services/agent_service_wiring.dart',
 'lifecycle': 'lib/services/agent_service_lifecycle.dart',
 'inbox': 'lib/services/agent_service_inbox.dart',
 'sessions': 'lib/services/agent_service_sessions.dart',
}

def find_block(sig_re):
    pat = re.compile(sig_re)
    hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.match(l)]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        print(f'FATAL: {sig_re!r} matched {len(hits)}', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    i = hits[0]
    s = i
    while s - 1 >= 0 and (lines[s-1].startswith('  ///') or lines[s-1].startswith('  // ')):
        s -= 1
    depth = 0; started = False; e = i
    while e < len(lines):
        l = lines[e]
        depth += l.count('{') - l.count('}')
        if '{' in l: started = True
        e += 1
        if started and depth <= 0: break
        if not started and l.rstrip().endswith(';'): break
    return s, e - 1

blocks = {}; all_ranges = []
for group, sigs in MEMBERS.items():
    blocks[group] = []
    for sig in sigs:
        s, e = find_block(sig)
        blocks[group].append((s, e, '\n'.join(lines[s:e+1])))
        all_ranges.append((s, e))

all_ranges.sort()
for (s1, e1), (s2, e2) in zip(all_ranges, all_ranges[1:]):
    if s2 <= e1:
        print(f'FATAL: overlap {s1}-{e1} {s2}-{e2}', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)

# append into existing extension bodies (before the final '}' of the file)
for group, blocks_g in blocks.items():
    path = PART_FILES[group]
    fl = open(path).read().split('\n')
    idx = max(i for i, l in enumerate(fl) if l == '}')
    body = '\n\n'.join(t for _, _, t in blocks_g)
    fl[idx:idx] = ['', body]
    open(path, 'w').write('\n'.join(fl))
    print(f'appended {len(blocks_g)} members to {path}')

remove = set()
for s, e in all_ranges:
    remove.update(range(s, e + 1))
new_lines = [l for i, l in enumerate(lines) if i not in remove]
out_text = '\n'.join(new_lines)
out_text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', out_text)
open(SRC, 'w').write(out_text)
print(f'main file now {len(out_text.splitlines())} lines')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 3: move history @override members + their private fields into the
agent_service_history part as a MIXIN (extensions cannot satisfy the
`implements FaChatService` clause); also move the agentNetwork getter."""
import re, sys

SRC = 'lib/services/agent_service.dart'
lines = open(SRC).read().split('\n')

MEMBERS = [
   r'^  int\? get historyAboveCount',
   r'^  Future<List<TrajectoryHiddenRecordPreview>> Function\(',
   r'^  bool get historyLoading',
   r'^  int\? get historyTotalCount',
   r'^  bool get historyHasNewer',
   r'^  int\? get historyBelowCount',
   r'^  String\? get historyLoadError',
   r'^  Future<void> loadOlderHistory\(',
   r'^  Future<void> loadNewerHistory\(',
   r'^  Future<bool> jumpToMessage\(',
   r'^  List<SessionRecord>\? _viewBranch;',
   r'^  int\? _historyAboveCount;',
   r'^  bool _loadingHistory = false;',
   r'^  String\? _historyLoadError;',
   r'^  AgentNetworkController get agentNetwork',
]

def find_block(sig_re):
    pat = re.compile(sig_re)
    hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.match(l)]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        print(f'FATAL: {sig_re!r} matched {len(hits)}', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    i = hits[0]
    s = i
    while s - 1 >= 0 and (lines[s-1].startswith('  ///') or lines[s-1].startswith('  // ')):
        s -= 1
    # field declarations end at ';'
    if lines[i].rstrip().endswith(';'):
        return s, i
    depth = 0; started = False; e = i
    while e < len(lines):
        l = lines[e]
        depth += l.count('{') - l.count('}')
        if '{' in l: started = True
        e += 1
        if started and depth <= 0: break
        if not started and l.rstrip().endswith(';'): break
    return s, e - 1

blocks = []
for sig in MEMBERS:
    s, e = find_block(sig)
    blocks.append((s, e, '\n'.join(lines[s:e+1])))

blocks.sort()
for (s1, e1, _), (s2, e2, _) in zip(blocks, blocks[1:]):
    if s2 <= e1:
        print(f'FATAL: overlap {s1}-{e1} {s2}-{e2}', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)

hist_blocks = [b for b in blocks if 'agentNetwork' not in b[2]]
net_block = [b for b in blocks if 'agentNetwork' in b[2]][0]

# 1. convert agent_service_history.dart extension -> mixin, append members
hp = 'lib/services/agent_service_history.dart'
htext = open(hp).read()
htext = htext.replace(
    'extension AgentServiceHistory on AgentService {',
    'mixin AgentServiceHistory on ChangeNotifier {')
assert 'mixin AgentServiceHistory on ChangeNotifier' in htext
# update the doc comment above the extension
htext = htext.replace(
    "/// Windowed-history internals of [AgentService] (issue #135): the\n"
    "/// paging/jump helpers BEHIND the [FaChatService] history surface. The\n"
    "/// `@override` banner members themselves stay on the class (an\n"
    "/// `implements` clause is satisfied only by real class members); these\n"
    "/// helpers share the class's private state (same library).",
    "/// Windowed-history surface of [AgentService] (issue #135): the\n"
    "/// [FaChatService] banner overrides, the paging/jump helpers behind\n"
    "/// them, and their private view state. A MIXIN (not an extension) so\n"
    "/// the `implements FaChatService` clause on [AgentService] is still\n"
    "/// satisfied and subclass overrides keep working; the remaining state\n"
    "/// it reads lives on the class (same library).")
append_body = '\n\n'.join(t for _, _, t in hist_blocks)
hl = htext.split('\n')
idx = max(i for i, l in enumerate(hl) if l == '}')
hl[idx:idx] = ['', append_body]
open(hp, 'w').write('\n'.join(hl))
print(f'converted {hp} to mixin, appended {len(hist_blocks)} members')

# 2. agentNetwork getter -> wiring part
wp = 'lib/services/agent_service_wiring.dart'
wl = open(wp).read().split('\n')
idx = max(i for i, l in enumerate(wl) if l == '}')
wl[idx:idx] = ['', net_block[2]]
open(wp, 'w').write('\n'.join(wl))
print(f'appended agentNetwork to {wp}')

# 3. remove from main + add `with AgentServiceHistory` to the class decl
remove = set()
for s, e, _ in blocks:
    remove.update(range(s, e + 1))
new_lines = [l for i, l in enumerate(lines) if i not in remove]
out = '\n'.join(new_lines)
out = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', out)
old_decl = 'class AgentService extends ChangeNotifier\n    implements FaChatConnection, FaApprovalModeController, FaChatService {'
new_decl = 'class AgentService extends ChangeNotifier\n    with AgentServiceHistory\n    implements FaChatConnection, FaApprovalModeController, FaChatService {'
assert out.count(old_decl) == 1
out = out.replace(old_decl, new_decl)
open(SRC, 'w').write(out)
print(f'main file now {len(out.splitlines())} lines')

import glob, re

    c = Counter()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Definitive split of agent_service.dart into part files (one shot, from pristine files)."""
import re, sys

SRC = 'lib/services/agent_service.dart'
lines = open(SRC).read().split('\n')

MEMBERS = {
 'wiring': [
   r'^  StreamFunction _streamFunctionFor\(',
   r'^  void _attachRedactor\(',
   r'^  void _registerRedactionSecret\(',
   r'^  void _attachApproval\(',
   r'^  List<String> get registeredToolNamesForTest',
   r'^  List<Tool> get toolsForTest',
   r'^  String get systemPromptForTest',
   r'^  SecretsExecutionEnv\? get secretsEnvForTest',
   r'^  SecretRedactor\? get redactorForTest',
   r'^  SkillsAccess get skillsAccess',
   r'^  Future<void> setSkillsAccess\(',
   r'^  String _composeSystemPrompt\(',
   r'^  String _messagingSection\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _refreshMemorySection\(',
   r'^  String\? _projectMountNote\(',
   r'^  void refreshProjectMountPrompt\(',
   r'^  HarnessLlmSlot\? _resolveMemoryLlmSlot\(',
   r'^  AppLauncher\? get appLauncher',
   r'^  set appLauncher\(',
   r'^  Future<List<AskAnswer>\?> _answerAskQuestions\(',
   r'^  Future<RequestSecretResult\?> _handleSecretRequest\(',
   r'^  Map<String, String> hostSecrets\(\)',
   r'^  Future<RequestSecretResult> acceptSecretGrant\(',
   r'^  ToolsConfig get toolsConfig',
   r'^  String get agentModelId',
   r'^  AgentNetworkController get agentNetwork',
 ],
 'history': [
   r'^  WindowedSessionStorage\? get _windowed',
   r'^  Future<void> _syncViewToWindow\(',
   r'^  int\? _positionalRow\(',
   r'^  Future<bool> _jumpLoadedRecord\(',
   r'^  Future<bool> _jumpToRecord\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _refreshHistoryAbove\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _applyViewBranch\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _reprojectLoadedWindow\(',
 ],
 'watch': [
   r'^  void _startSessionWatch\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _checkSessionFileGrew\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _reloadExternalMessages\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _growProviderContext\(',
   r'^  void _stopSessionWatch\(',
 ],
 'media': [
   r'^  bool get inlinesImageAttachments',
   r'^  MediaGateway\? get mediaGateway',
   r'^  VideoReader\? get videoReader',
   r'^  Future<AsrTranscriber\?> resolveAsrTranscriber\(',
   r'^  Future<void> sendImage\(',
 ],
 'background': [
   r'^  Future<void> _beginBackgroundTask\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _finishLiveActivity\(',
   r'^  String _liveActivityStatusText\(',
   r'^  void _pushLiveActivityStatus\(',
 ],
 'subagents': [
   r'^  SubagentManager\? get subagentManager',
   r'^  set subagentManager\(',
   r'^  Future<List<\(String, String\)>> observeSubagent\(',
   r'^  Future<void> sendToSubagent\(',
   r'^  SessionMetadata _subagentSessionMetadata\(',
   r'^  DynamicMessagesService _buildDynamicMessages\(',
   r'^  Future<RequestSecretResult\?> _requestSecretForWidget\(',
 ],
 'lifecycle': [
   r'^  void _clearError\(',
   r'^  String _shortArgs\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _flushDynamicWidgets\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _flushRequestSummaries\(',
   r'^  Future<void> _rebuildTrajectory\(',
   r'^  TrajectoryBlobPersister _trajectoryBlobPersisterFor\(',
   r'^  bool get providerAddFlowInProgress',
   r'^  bool reconfigureRefusedByAddFlow\(',
   r'^  void beginProviderAddFlow\(\)',

 ],
 'inbox': [

   r'^  set inboxWakeStreakForTest\(',

 ],
 'sessions': [
   r'^  String\? get currentSessionId',
   r'^  String\? get currentSessionCwd',
   r'^  AgentConfig\? get configForClone',
 ],
}

def is_anno_or_doc(l):
    s = l.strip()
    return (l.startswith('  ///') or l.startswith('  //')
            or (l.startswith('  @') and not s.endswith('{') and '(' not in s))

def find_block(sig_re):
    pat = re.compile(sig_re)
    hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.match(l)]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        print(f'FATAL: {sig_re!r} matched {len(hits)}', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
    i = hits[0]
    s = i
    while s - 1 >= 0 and is_anno_or_doc(lines[s-1]):
        s -= 1
    if lines[i].rstrip().endswith(';'):  # field / expression-bodied one-liner
        return s, i
    depth = 0; started = False; e = i
    while e < len(lines):
        l = lines[e]
        depth += l.count('{') - l.count('}')
        if depth > 0:
            started = True
        e += 1
        if started and depth == 0:
            break
        if not started and l.rstrip().endswith(';'):
            break
    return s, e - 1

blocks = {}; all_ranges = []
for group, sigs in MEMBERS.items():
    blocks[group] = []
    for sig in sigs:
        s, e = find_block(sig)
        blocks[group].append((s, e, '\n'.join(lines[s:e+1])))
        all_ranges.append((s, e))

all_ranges.sort()
for (s1, e1), (s2, e2) in zip(all_ranges, all_ranges[1:]):
    if s2 <= e1:
        print(f'FATAL: overlap {s1}-{e1} {s2}-{e2}', file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
print(f'all {len(all_ranges)} blocks found, no overlaps')

def fix(group, text):
    if group == 'background':
        text = text.replace('if (_inWidgetTest)', 'if (AgentService._inWidgetTest)')
    if group == 'media':
        text = text.replace('!_isOnDeviceKind(providerKind)', '!AgentService._isOnDeviceKind(providerKind)')
        text = text.replace('notifyListeners();', '_notify();')
    if group == 'subagents':
        text = text.replace('ensureSendableSubagent(handle, id);', 'AgentService.ensureSendableSubagent(handle, id);')
        text = text.replace('return tailMessagePairs(', 'return AgentService.tailMessagePairs(')
    if group == 'wiring':
        text = text.replace('notifyListeners();', '_notify();')
    if group == 'lifecycle':
        text = text.replace('notifyListeners();', '_notify();')
    return text

HEADER = """// Copyright (c) 2026, the Flutter Agent Harness authors.
// Use of this source code is governed by a MIT license that can be found
// in the LICENSE file.

part of 'agent_service.dart';
"""

PARTS = {
 'wiring': ('agent_service_wiring.dart', 'AgentServiceWiring',
   "/// Backend wiring of [AgentService]: the stream-function picker, the\n"
   "/// redaction + approval attachment, the skills/tools consent setters,\n"
   "/// the system-prompt composition, and the secret-request host\n"
   "/// handlers. The private state they drive stays on the class in\n"
   "/// `agent_service.dart` (extensions hold no instance state; same\n"
   "/// library, so private members resolve)."),
 'history': ('agent_service_history.dart', 'AgentServiceHistory',
   "/// Windowed-history internals of [AgentService] (issue #135): the\n"
   "/// paging/jump/view helpers BEHIND the [FaChatService] history\n"
   "/// surface. The `@override` banner members themselves stay on the\n"
   "/// class — an `implements` clause is satisfied only by real class\n"
   "/// members — these helpers share its private state (same library)."),
 'media': ('agent_service_media.dart', 'AgentServiceMedia',
   "/// Media surface of [AgentService]: the gateway/video-reader accessors\n"
   "/// behind the `jsr.fa.media.*` bridges, the ASR transcriber\n"
   "/// resolution, and the plain-image send path. The [FaChatService]\n"
   "/// attachment overrides and the private gateway fields stay on the\n"
   "/// class; notifications route through `_notify()` (`notifyListeners`\n"
   "/// is @protected, callable only inside the class)."),
 'background': ('agent_service_background.dart', 'AgentServiceBackground',
   "/// Background-execution + Live Activity helpers of [AgentService]\n"
   "/// (the iOS Dynamic Island / lock-screen run status): the\n"
   "/// [isStreaming] setter that drives them is an `@override` and stays\n"
   "/// on the class; these helpers share its private state (same\n"
   "/// library)."),
 'subagents': ('agent_service_subagents.dart', 'AgentServiceSubagents',
   "/// Subagent observe/send surface of [AgentService] (the settings\n"
   "/// Agents section) plus the dynamic-messages host factory and the\n"
   "/// widget secret-request backend (issue #102). The private managers\n"
   "/// stay on the class; static helpers are qualified with\n"
   "/// [AgentService] (extensions resolve unqualified statics of the\n"
   "/// extended type only via the class name)."),
 'lifecycle': ('agent_service_lifecycle.dart', 'AgentServiceLifecycle',
   "/// Session-lifecycle internals of [AgentService]: the error clearing,\n"
   "/// the service teardown behind [AgentService.dispose] (everything but\n"
   "/// the `super.dispose()` call, which must stay on the class — an\n"
   "/// extension has no super), the trajectory-ledger rebuild, and the\n"
   "/// dynamic-widget / request-capture record flushes that ride the\n"
   "/// persist pass. The state fields they drive stay on the class (same\n"
   "/// library)."),
}

for group, (fname, extname, doc) in PARTS.items():
    body = '\n\n'.join(fix(group, t) for _, _, t in blocks[group])
    out = HEADER + '\n' + doc + '\nextension ' + extname + ' on AgentService {\n' + body + '\n}\n'
    open('lib/services/' + fname, 'w').write(out)
    print(f'wrote lib/services/{fname}: {len(out.splitlines())} lines')

# --- dispose split: move body (minus super.dispose()) into lifecycle part ---
pat = re.compile(r'^  void dispose\(\) \{')
hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines) if pat.match(l)]
assert len(hits) == 1
i = hits[0]
s = i
while s - 1 >= 0 and is_anno_or_doc(lines[s-1]):
    s -= 1
# find end
depth = 0; e = i
while e < len(lines):
    depth += lines[e].count('{') - lines[e].count('}')
    e += 1
    if depth == 0:
        break
e -= 1
dispose_doc_and_sig = '\n'.join(lines[s:i+1])  # doc + '@override' + signature
dispose_body = lines[i+1:e]  # exclude closing '}'
assert 'super.dispose();' in dispose_body
new_body = [l for l in dispose_body if l.strip() != 'super.dispose();']
all_ranges.append((s, e))
print(f'dispose block: lines {s}-{e}')

# remove everything (member blocks + dispose) from main
remove = set()
for st, en in all_ranges:
    remove.update(range(st, en + 1))
new_lines = [l for i2, l in enumerate(lines) if i2 not in remove]

# insert the slim dispose + part directive anchor
dispose_new = dispose_doc_and_sig + '\n    _disposeService();\n    super.dispose();\n  }'
anchor = '  Session? _session;'
assert sum(1 for l in new_lines if l == anchor) == 1
out_lines = []
for l in new_lines:
    if l == anchor:
        out_lines.append(dispose_new)
        out_lines.append('')
    out_lines.append(l)
out_text = '\n'.join(out_lines)
out_text = re.sub(r'\n{3,}', '\n\n', out_text)

# append dispose body + watch/inbox/sessions groups into existing parts
def append_to(path, text):
    fl = open(path).read().split('\n')
    idx = max(k for k, l in enumerate(fl) if l == '}')
    fl[idx:idx] = ['', text]
    open(path, 'w').write('\n'.join(fl))

dispose_part = (
    "/// The service teardown behind [AgentService.dispose]: everything\n"
    "/// except the `super.dispose()` call, which must stay on the class\n"
    "/// (an extension has no super). Extracted with the rest of the\n"
    "/// lifecycle internals so the main file stays under the line cap.\n"
    "void _disposeService() {\n" + '\n'.join(new_body) + '\n}')
append_to(PARTS['lifecycle'][0], dispose_part)
print('appended _disposeService to lifecycle part')

append_to('lib/services/agent_service_sessions.dart',
          '\n\n'.join(fix('watch', t) for _, _, t in blocks['watch'])
          + '\n\n' + '\n\n'.join(t for _, _, t in blocks['sessions']))
print('appended watch + session-id members to sessions part')

append_to('lib/services/agent_service_inbox.dart',
          '\n\n'.join(t for _, _, t in blocks['inbox']))
print('appended test seams to inbox part')

anchor_part = "part 'agent_service_inbox.dart';"
new_parts = '\n'.join(f"part '{PARTS[g][0]}';" for g in ('history', 'wiring', 'media', 'background', 'subagents', 'lifecycle'))
assert out_text.count(anchor_part) == 1
out_text = out_text.replace(anchor_part, anchor_part + '\n' + new_parts)
open(SRC, 'w').write(out_text)
print(f'main file now {len(out_text.splitlines())} lines')
